content.value_statement: Data teams often struggle to connect data assets to validated revenue opportunities. This skill provides a structured, auditable path from value discovery to monetization operations.
actual_capabilities: Maps data assets across value types, quality, ownership, scale, and possible use cases.
Prioritizes candidate use cases by value, feasibility, buyer evidence, and compliance readiness.
Compares monetization paths, including direct sales, subscriptions, services, and revenue sharing.
Drafts a phased data monetization roadmap with owners, deliverables, metrics, and validation steps.
Defines operating metrics for recurring revenue, asset use, renewal, return, and value decay.
Flags when legal, accounting, valuation, or regulatory advice requires a qualified professional.
limitations: It provides planning guidance and does not guarantee revenue, financing, or a completed transaction.
It cannot verify data ownership, consent, contracts, market demand, or legal compliance without source evidence.
It does not replace legal, accounting, valuation, financial, or regulatory professionals.
Its policy references require current verification before use in a decision or external document.

use_cases.title: Assess an internal data portfolio
use_cases.description: Inventory enterprise data assets and identify the most promising value and use-case opportunities.

use_cases.title: Design a recurring revenue model
use_cases.description: Compare service, subscription, transaction, and revenue-sharing models for a data product.

use_cases.title: Build an operating roadmap
use_cases.description: Create a phased plan for launch, measurement, renewal, and ongoing data asset operations.

prompt_templates.title: Identify data value
prompt_templates.prompt: List the data assets we have: [assets]. Identify likely value types, missing evidence, and the first three discovery questions.

prompt_templates.title: Prioritize use cases
prompt_templates.prompt: For this data asset: [description], propose up to five use cases. Rank them by buyer need, feasibility, compliance readiness, and expected validation effort.

prompt_templates.title: Compare monetization options
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare direct sale, data service, subscription, transaction commission, and revenue sharing for [data product]. State assumptions, risks, metrics, and a recommended pilot.

prompt_templates.title: Produce a monetization roadmap
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 90-day monetization roadmap for [organization and data assets]. Include ownership, milestones, evidence gates, buyer validation, compliance review, pricing tests, and operating metrics.

output_examples.input: Assess customer service interaction data for monetization.
output: Value hypothesis: operational benchmarks and service-quality insights.
Priority pilot: anonymized benchmark report for a defined industry segment.
Evidence needed: data rights, consent scope, buyer interviews, and quality measurements.

output_examples.input: Create a plan for a data subscription product.
output: Recommended model: annual subscription with a limited pilot tier.
First milestone: validate three buyers, a pricing range, and a repeatable update process.
Operating metrics: active subscribers, renewal rate, recurring revenue share, and data freshness.

best_practices: Document data ownership, consent, contract limits, and permitted uses before designing a monetization offer.
Validate buyer demand with named users, budget evidence, and a testable deliverable before scaling.
State assumptions, evidence gaps, pricing logic, and professional-review needs in every recommendation.
anti_patterns: Do not treat estimated asset value as guaranteed revenue or a guaranteed financing outcome.
Do not commercialize data before confirming rights, privacy obligations, and contractual restrictions.
Do not select a business model without testing buyer demand, delivery capacity, and ongoing data quality.

faq.question: Who should use this skill?
faq.answer: Data strategy, product, business development, and data asset operations teams can use it to structure monetization planning.

faq.question: What inputs produce the best result?
faq.answer: Provide data descriptions, ownership evidence, quality information, target buyers, existing contracts, and commercial goals.

faq.question: Can it determine the legal right to sell data?
faq.answer: No. It can identify questions for review, but qualified legal and privacy professionals must assess rights and obligations.

faq.question: Does it provide a data valuation?
faq.answer: It can organize value assumptions and evidence. Formal valuation requires appropriate qualified professionals and verified information.

faq.question: Can it guarantee a revenue outcome?
faq.answer: No. It supports hypotheses, prioritization, and validation planning. Revenue depends on market demand and execution.

faq.question: How should teams start?
faq.answer: Start with a small set of data assets, confirm rights and quality, interview potential buyers, and run a narrow pilot.
